column1: # adapters.tsv — how check-audit.sh runs each check a floor can list.
# The other plugins' checkers take options; they do not read the contract. Each
# row turns one contract key into one option (or input) of one checker, as that
# fails when a row names an option the checker's usage line does not have.
# Columns, tab-separated; "-" is an empty cell:
#   option   the option, or "-" for an input given by position
#   kind     scalar  the option and the key's value, when the key is set
#            list    the option once for each value the key pattern matches
#            csv     the option once, with the matching values joined by commas
#            fmt     the option once for each entry of a list of maps, built from
#                    the template in the last column: {k} a field; {k,} a list
#                    field joined by commas; {k,-} the same, "-" when empty;
#                    {k?TEXT} TEXT when the field is true. An entry with a field
#                    missing is left out and reported (GOV-S2).
#            const   the option, with the last column as its value
#            today   the option and the date of the run
#            nogit   the option, when check-audit.sh itself runs with --no-git
#            files   the option once for each of the files named in the last
#                    column that exists at the repository root
#            pos     an input: the key's value, else the last column
#            posdir  inputs: the folder of each glob the key pattern matches.
#                    It has no default: when the contract does not give the
#                    key, the check is unmeasured (GOV-L2), because nothing
#            each    the checker runs once for each dated record
#                    (YYYY-MM-DD-<name>.md) in the folder the key names, else in
#                    the last column; only records since the last signed launch
#   key      the contract key; "[*]" stands for every item of a list
#   last     a default, a template or a list of file names, by kind
